shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" transit animations with a real pre-hop delay, blueprint art, wall risers, Perspective Shift support. Workshop 3776015553, window 10 shipped. Window 11: §78 UNTESTED IN THE FIELD.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §45-50 field-report fixes; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED by §78); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion-study round 2 (CLOSED, Traveler picked) + §77b the railing bug + §77c art defects; **§78 TRAVELER + REAL PRE-HOP DELAY + §78b the four field fixes - RE-TEST PENDING**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~118 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 11. §78 ran in the field once (run #1 of the window). It did NOT deadlock - cross-level movement worked - but produced three visual defects, all fixed in §78b. §78b compiles 0w/0e and HAS NOT BEEN RUN.**

**⚠ THE #297 QUESTION IS ANSWERED: THE HOLD DOES NOT DEADLOCK.** The first §78 run produced no stuck pawns and no bridge errors; the user reported only cosmetics. That is the single most important result of the window - the mechanism in §78 (defer the MOVE, not the DECISION) is sound where the run-#297 mechanism was not. Do not let a later regression be re-diagnosed from scratch: if pawns ever stall at stairwells again, the suspect list starts with `EntryCellFor` (§78b), not with the hold.

Window 10 shipped §74/§75/§76 to Workshop 3776015553, pushed as **`afaf614`**. §78 is NOT committed.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD.** `build_mod` has no `-c Release`. Rebuild Release before any publish.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **RE-TEST §78b.** (2) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** from the WORKSHOP copy - never yet done for any window. (3) **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE kit prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). (4) **FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT** (ledger 3). (5) **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites are unrotated; user's domain. (6) §62.N formal line. (7) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (8) §70 Caverns verify. (9) Delete the retired ghost stubs once §78 is proven.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ SHIPPED WITH PLACEHOLDER ART:** the 12 riser PNGs, by explicit user decision.

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY-FOUR RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET - SUSPEND THE OTHER DRIVER INSTEAD. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL - and the far end is a DIFFERENT thing with its own axis. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** A safe delay and a deadlock look identical from outside; what separates them is whether the deferred thing can decline to happen. 44 (§78b): **AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT, AND EVERY OVERLAY STAYS BEHIND.** If a clip moves a sprite off its thing, (a) ease the offset from zero or the first frame is a jump, and (b) every UI element positioned from `DrawPos` - label, bars, anything through `GenMapUI.LabelDrawPosFor` - is now pointing at the wrong place and must be moved with it.

Decompile each, find the print entry point, add a `Hosts` row if it is thing-side, PROVE it with `AB2: carrier probe`'s patch census.

**⚠ KNOWN-BENIGN FOREIGN NOISE:** VFEM2 TorchWallLamp MakeThing error; Rimefeller `discord.dds` `f2fab05fc732a605`; Rimefeller `CompOilDerrick.setfull` NRE (`#fc35ef297211de6b`). NONE ARE OURS.

# 1-30 — unchanged. # 31 PUBLISHING — docs/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md is authoritative; strip = SIX moves (Source, Tools, docs, .git, mockups, .gitignore) to a staging dir OUTSIDE `Mods/`; the utility pushes FILES + PREVIEW ONLY. # 32-72 — unchanged.

# 73. TRANSIT ANIMATIONS (V1) — SUPERSEDED BY §78

Kept for the lesson. §73 shipped an INVERTED delay: instant carry, latency afterwards, as a ghost redrawn at the origin mouth while the real pawn stood at the destination. It existed because run #297 had deadlocked on a pre-hop hold. Its costs - a ghost draw pass, a hide pose, a suppressed name label, and a knowingly-shipped lie where the pawn was hittable at a destination it appeared not to be at - are all deleted by §78.

# 74. BLUEPRINT ART — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

`ABBlueprintLook` static-ctor retint; `Blueprint_ABBuild` stuff tint; `ABGhostGraphicForLinks` IsDoor bypass. Single knob `ABBlueprintLook.BlueprintAlpha`, consumed in TWO places (the generated blueprint `GraphicData.color` and `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor`, which must re-apply it over the stuff colour or a stuffed plan comes back opaque). **§74.b:** 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT; now **0.42**, below vanilla's own 0.6, because our art is full-colour where vanilla's is a desaturated wash. ⚠ NOT field-confirmed at the new value.

# 75. WALL RISERS — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED, PLACEHOLDER ART

4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment mechanics; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn with its wall. Architect uiOrder: links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083. **§75.g `AB2: carrier probe`** - per-cell drawerType/IsCarrier/ShouldPrint census plus a live Harmony patch census. **Keep this tool.** **§75.h:** Dubwise layers derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, and print from `Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid` - the old patch bound nothing and failed silently for two windows. Now patched per host, deduped by MethodInfo, prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument so unrecognised layers print rather than hide (rule 34, fail-safe direction).

# 76. PERSPECTIVE SHIFT — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

Suspend `Avatar.UpdateCamera` via a parameterless prefix while the viewed band is not the avatar's (rule 39). On transit, snap the camera and NULL `Avatar.physicsPosition`. Freeze via `State.CameraLockPosition`; `lockedByUs` guards release. Cross-band shooting and traversal needed no code: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch. ⚠ NOT re-tested since §78 changed the transit timing.

# 77. MOTION STUDY ROUND 2 — CLOSED. TRAVELER PICKED.

Five animation languages in `mockups/anim-A..E-*.html` over a shared kit; each covers all four link types on the REAL art with a 4-facing pawn, a scrubbable timeline, a Perspective Shift avatar view, gold/red footprint edge markers and a live C#-port panel. Machine-checked for NaN/range AND for railing crossings across 4 rotations x 2 directions x 61 samples. **User picked C - Traveler at 0.30 playback** and asked for the delay to move BEFORE the hop. A/B/D/E remain on disk; **D's structure-animation track (the building reacts - dimming stairs, flexing ladder, sinking elevator car) is the one idea worth revisiting** and is orthogonal to what shipped.

**⚠ §77a FACING (rule 41).** `PawnDrawParms.facing` is a writable `Rot4` on the struct our GetDrawParms postfix already takes by ref. Never set, so pawns kept whatever the pather left - usually south, i.e. walking backwards downstairs. **⚠ ALPHA RE-CHECKED, STILL NO:** `tint` is writable but pawn materials are cutout; alpha needs `PawnRenderFlags.Invisible`, which routes every node through `InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat` - a distortion shader with a hard-coded cyan multiply. A cloak, not a fade. Scale stays the only vanish channel.

**§77b THE RAILING BUG, BOTH ENDS.** Settled by decoding the PNGs. Every `*_south` sprite has its notch on its **NORTH** edge (`AB_StairsDown_south` north-edge coverage 42% vs 88/99/87), shading light->dark southward. **Entry edge = `Opposite(Rotation)`, run direction = `Rotation.FacingCell`.** ⚠ **The counterpart shares this end's `Rotation` and that is load-bearing** (`GenAdj.AdjustForRotation` shifts even-sized footprints; `TryCellPairs` pairs cell i to cell i) - **DO NOT FLIP IT**. Same rotation ⇒ same notch side ⇒ a pawn surfacing there arrives at the DEEP end and exits along `-far.Rotation.FacingCell`.

**⚠ §77c ART DEFECTS - USER'S DOMAIN, NOT TOUCHED.** (a) `AB_GrandStairsDown/Up_east`/`_west` are the NORTH composition unrotated (1.85 x 2.43 cells) - treads run across the direction of travel. (b) `AB_StairsDown_east/_west` are a different composition from the north/south pair and sit 0.42 cells north. (c) `AB_StairsUp_east/_west` span the full 2 cells with no notch on any edge. (d) `AB_LadderUp_east` is a 0.14-cell sliver drawn 0.30 cells west of its own cell. `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets` transcribes these honestly rather than correcting them.

# 78. TRAVELER + REAL PRE-HOP DELAY

**The shape.** `Carry` splits into `BeginCrossing` (start the hold) / `TickCrossings` (age it) / `CarryNow` (position write and everything downstream). Both teleport sites - the tick sweep AND `TryConsumeArrival` - route through it, so which trigger fires first cannot change whether the clip plays.

**⚠⚠ WHY THIS IS NOT RUN #297 (rule 43), AND THE FIELD NOW AGREES.** #297 held the pawn by REFUSING AN ARRIVAL: it gated `TryConsumeArrival`, vanilla's `PatherArrived` never ran, the leg never completed, the job re-issued `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segmented, and the pawn re-arrived forever. **The transit DECISION was deferred, behind a cosmetic condition.** §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE: by the time `BeginCrossing` runs the record has already left `pending` and `everSegmented`, so there is no leg left to re-segment. The pawn is held by **`pather.StopDead()` + `StaggerFor`**, never by refusing an arrival - StopDead releases the path and clears `moving` WITHOUT notifying the JobDriver, so the waiting toil just waits, no arrival fires at the stairwell, and with `moving` false `PatherTick` never re-tests `AtDestinationPosition`, so there is no per-tick loop. On the arrival path, returning true (suppressing vanilla's `PatherArrived`) is load-bearing and safe ONLY because StopDead already ran.

**Every exit teleports or abandons.** Anchor lost → `EndCurrentJob(Incompletable)` (⚠ required: the pawn is on a stopped pather under a PatherArrival toil = `ABStuckWatchdog` episode B). Job changed → cancel, NO teleport (something else took command). Pawn moved off its hold cell → fire early. `MaxHoldTicks` 300 backstops all of it; `StuckTicks` is 180 and the longest hold is 78, so normal holds never trip the watchdog and a lost one does.

**Durations (`ABStairAnim`, the one knob).** Half-windows: stairs 40, grand 46, ladder 56, elevator 50 + 14/level capped 78. Crossings 1.33 / 1.53 / 1.87 / 1.67-2.6 s. ⚠ One of two defensible readings of the user's 0.30 approval: in the study both halves ran SIMULTANEOUSLY, sequentially they cannot, so the approved window is split evenly - preserving the felt length of the crossing at the cost of each half's curve running twice as fast as seen. **If the motion reads hurried rather than the crossing reading long, DOUBLE these.**

**§78b THE FOUR FIELD FIXES (run 1 report: "teleports into the centre of the stairs, nameplate in the wrong location, facing the wrong way").** All three symptoms had ONE root cause: **the clip is authored about the LINK, but nothing required the pawn to be standing at the link.** That gap was knowingly deferred in §78 as "its own reviewed change"; the field says it is load-bearing, not optional.

1. **TRAVEL, NOT TELEPORT (rule 44a).** The entry pose carried an absolute `baseX/baseZ` that snapped the sprite onto the link's drawn centre on frame one - and `ArriveRadius` is 3, so that snap could be three cells. Replaced with `travelX/travelZ`, the whole walk from where the pawn actually stands to just past the mouth, scaled by each pose's own easing so **every entry clip now starts at offset zero**. The grand staircase's lateral rail offset is eased in over the first quarter for the same reason, and its emerge term now resolves to `(1 - pe)` rather than `(1 - pe*0.5)` so the clip does not hand back a pawn a quarter-cell off its own tile.
2. **THE LABEL FOLLOWS THE SPRITE (rule 44b).** New postfix on `GenMapUI.LabelDrawPosFor(Thing, float)` adds the clip offset. ⚠ The delta is computed in SCREEN space by projecting both endpoints, because the vanilla result is already projected AND vertically flipped (`result.y = screenHeight - result.y`) - hence the y term subtracts. §73 hid the label instead; moving it is strictly better.
3. **FACING FROM THE ACTUAL VECTOR.** `dirX/dirZ` is now the unit direction of the motion actually being drawn (entry: pawn → mouth; emerge: mouth → landing), not `Rotation.FacingCell`. The link's axis is right only when the pawn stands on the link's entry side, and with the fallback in (4) that is not guaranteed - a pawn walking one way while facing the other is worse than a pawn walking in on a slightly wrong line.
4. **ENTRY-SIDE PATHING - `EntryCellFor`.** `TrySegment` now rewrites the destination to the cell one step beyond the footprint on the edge OPPOSITE the link's facing, centred on the run, instead of to the building itself. ⚠ **Edge taken from `OccupiedRect`, not from `Position`** - for an even-sized footprint `GenAdj.AdjustForRotation` means Position is not the geometric centre. ⚠ **Every failure returns `IntVec3.Invalid` and the caller falls back to the old `dest = near` verbatim**: a link whose entry cell is walled in, out of bounds, in the gutter or unreachable must stay USABLE, because refusing to path is the ladder-to-nowhere class of bug. Checks are ordered cheap-first (bounds, standable, same band) with `CanReach` last.

**Draw side.** `ClipPose.facing` written to `__result.facing` in the existing GetDrawParms postfix - never `pawn.Rotation`, so gameplay reads are untouched and it self-reverts. `ArtOffsets` shifts the clip onto the treads that are actually painted.

**⚠ RETIRED STUBS, NOT DELETED.** `IsGhosting` returns constant false and `DrawGhosts` is a no-op, both documented, because they have live call sites in `ABBelowDynamicDraw`. Delete once §78 is proven.
